_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for FANG (Diamondback Energy, Inc., CIK 1539838), generated by retro/generators/fang/gen_fang.py from the filings; every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after its 'published' date (EDGAR's acceptance time in ET: accepted at or after 16:00, the next trading day). It holds what decides whether a date can be built under method r2, and nothing else: each offering document's and 10-K's annual history, the FY2012 first-day tax charge, the listing record, the no-dividend statement and the price basis. No share of Diamondback traded before 2012-10-12; the predecessors were limited liability companies with no shares, and no filing to 2013-12-31 prints a GAAP earnings per share for any full year (2012's only per-share figure is pro forma), so no date of 2008-2013 has a full year of the company's own EPS to anchor a P/E and none is built (retro/README.md, "FANG 2008-2009"). No print, guide, signal or theme event is transcribed, and the builder refuses any date that passes the gate until they are. | 2014-2017: extended by retro/generators/fang/gen_fang_1417.py with the FY2013-FY2016 10-K vintages (gate periods and model fields), the prints Q3 2013-Q3 2017 with each Q4 release's year and its one-off test, and the rule-T values; FY2013 is the first full year of Diamondback's own EPS (retro/README.md, "FANG 2014-2017"). | 2018-2021: extended by retro/generators/fang/gen_fang_1821.py with the FY2017-FY2020 10-K vintages, the prints Q4 2017-Q3 2021 with each Q4 release's year and its one-off test, and the dividend rates (retro/README.md, "FANG 2018-2021").
price_basis: Yahoo's FANG series is Diamondback Energy, Inc.'s common stock (NASDAQ: FANG) from its first point, 2012-10-12 (firstTradeDate), the first trading day the FY2012 10-K states; Yahoo's series records no split. history_vintages.first_day_quote: On the date of the merger, a corresponding “first day” tax expense to net income from continuing operations was recorded to establish a net deferred tax liability for differences between the tax and book basis of Diamondback’s assets and liabilities. This charge was $54,142,000.
history_vintages.llc_quote: The operations of Windsor Permian and Windsor UT, as limited liability companies, were not subject to federal income taxes.

history_vintages.business_quote: We are an independent oil and natural gas company currently focused on the acquisition, development, exploration and exploitation of unconventional, onshore oil and natural gas reserves in the Permian Basin in West Texas.
history_vintages.cyclical_quote: The oil and natural gas industry is cyclical, which can result in shortages of drilling rigs, equipment, raw materials (particularly sand and other proppants), supplies and personnel.

history_vintages.no_dividend_quote: We have not paid any cash dividends since our inception.
history_vintages.transition_quote: The adoption of climate change legislation by Congress could result in increased operating costs and reduced demand for the oil and natural gas we produce.

rule_t._doc: Rule T over the annual changes the filings public on 2014-02-21 (the first built date) report, each from the latest filing that reports both years: the FY2013 10-K (Item 2's production and price history for 2011-2013, Item 6 for 2009-2013) and the FY2012 10-K (2010's production and unit cost, 2008's revenue and income before income taxes); the Predecessors' years as the 10-Ks present them (combined under common control). Lease operating expense per BOE is on each 10-K's own basis (the FY2013 10-K moves ad valorem taxes out of it and corporate overhead into it).
